<p> </p>

These exercises are about using the Signac object to handle data for [Single-cell ATAC-seq](https://rockefelleruniversity.github.io/scATAC/).

In this exercise we will be using a dataset of 5K flash frozen embryonic (E18) mouse brain cells. [Here is a link](https://www.10xgenomics.com/datasets/flash-frozen-cortex-hippocampus-and-ventricular-zone-from-embryonic-mouse-brain-e-18-1-standard-1-2-0){target="_blank"} to the Cell Ranger ATAC output files.

**Exercise 1** - **Cell Ranger ATAC web summary**

-   This is data from flash frozen tissue, which is harder to isolate and often leads to QC that is not as clean as something like PBMCs. Download the web summary html file and look carefully through the QC metrics. Note how these data differ from the 500 cell PBMC dataset we looked at in the course.

    -   [Link to html summary](https://cf.10xgenomics.com/samples/cell-atac/1.2.0/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k_web_summary.html){target="_blank"}
    -   Note: this was processed with an older version of Cell Ranger ATAC, leading to subtle differences in the report.

**Exercise 2** - **Read Cell Ranger ATAC outputs into R**

-   Download the following files and create a Seurat object.

    -   Fragments (TSV) : warning - large file (1.1 GB)
    -   Fragments index (TBI)
    -   Peak by cell matrix HDF5 (filtered)
    -   Per Barcode metrics (CSV): this is the singlecell.csv metadata file

```{r,echo=toMessage, eval=F}
download.file("https://cf.10xgenomics.com/samples/cell-atac/1.2.0/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k_fragments.tsv.gz",
              destfile = "~/Downloads/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k_fragments.tsv.gz")

download.file("https://cf.10xgenomics.com/samples/cell-atac/1.2.0/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k_fragments.tsv.gz.tbi",
              destfile = "~/Downloads/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k_fragments.tsv.gz.tbi")

download.file("https://cf.10xgenomics.com/samples/cell-atac/1.2.0/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k_filtered_peak_bc_matrix.h5",
              destfile = "~/Downloads/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k_filtered_peak_bc_matrix.h5")

download.file("https://cf.10xgenomics.com/samples/cell-atac/1.2.0/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k_singlecell.csv",
              destfile = "~/Downloads/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k_singlecell.csv")
```

```{r,echo=toMessage, eval=F}
library(Signac)
library(Seurat)

metadata <- read.csv(
  file = "~/Downloads/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k_singlecell.csv",
  header = TRUE,
  row.names = 1
)

counts <- Read10X_h5(filename = "~/Downloads/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k_filtered_peak_bc_matrix.h5")
std_chr   <- paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X", "Y"))
peak_chr  <- as.character(seqnames(StringToGRanges(rownames(counts), sep = c(":", "-"))))
counts    <- counts[peak_chr %in% std_chr, ]

chrom_assay <- CreateChromatinAssay(
  counts = counts,
  sep = c(":", "-"),
  fragments = "~/Downloads/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k_fragments.tsv.gz",
  min.cells = 10,
  min.features = 200
)


seu_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = chrom_assay,
  assay = "peaks",
  meta.data = metadata
)

seu_obj
```

``` {.text code-line-numbers="false"}
An object of class Seurat 
53735 features across 3776 samples within 1 assay 
Active assay: peaks (53735 features, 0 variable features)
 2 layers present: counts, data
```

-   Print out the hash and the path of the fragment file from within the Seurat object

```{r,echo=toMessage, eval=F}
frags <- Fragments(seu_obj)  

GetFragmentData(frags[[1]], "hash")

```

``` {.text code-line-numbers="false"}
[1] "81f260f61c7101de5d154449720b053b" "884aa46b4bb08be53234caf9d1c72519"
```

```{r,echo=toMessage, eval=F}
GetFragmentData(frags[[1]], "path")
```

``` {.text code-line-numbers="false"}
[1] "~/Downloads/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k_fragments.tsv.gz"
```

-   Move the fragment file and its index to a different folder and update the path in the Seurat object.

```{r,echo=toMessage, eval=F}
file.rename("~/Downloads/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k_fragments.tsv.gz", 
            "~/Desktop/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k_fragments.tsv.gz")
file.rename("~/Downloads/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k_fragments.tsv.gz.tbi", 
            "~/Desktop/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k_fragments.tsv.gz.tbi")

frags_updated <- UpdatePath(
  frags[[1]],
  new.path = "~/Desktop/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k_fragments.tsv.gz"
)
Fragments(seu_obj) <- NULL
Fragments(seu_obj) <- frags_updated

GetFragmentData(Fragments(seu_obj)[[1]], "path")

```

``` {.text code-line-numbers="false"}
[1] "~/Desktop/atac_v1_E18_brain_flash_5k_fragments.tsv.gz"
```

peaks_seu <- granges(seu_obj)
peaks_seu

-   Identify the peak with the highest total raw counts

    -   HINT: use the peak counts

```{r,echo=toMessage, eval=F}
counts_seu <- GetAssayData(seu_obj, assay = "peaks", layer = "counts")
peak_sums <- rowSums(counts_seu)
max_peak_index <- which.max(peak_sums)
names(max_peak_index)

```

``` {.text code-line-numbers="false"}
[1] "chr17-39842785-39849048"
```

-   Identify the cell barcode with the highest total raw counts in peaks

    -   HINT: cell barcode metadata can be accessed with the seu_obj\@meta.data

```{r,echo=toMessage, eval=F}
meta_seu <- seu_obj@meta.data
max_meta_index <- which.max(meta_seu$nCount_peaks)
rownames(meta_seu)[max_meta_index]

```

``` {.text code-line-numbers="false"}
[1] "AACATCGGTTGGCTAT-1"
```
